name: 烈火守护
evolution: 火尾瓦特 → 火尾战士 Lv.20 → 烈火守护 Lv.40
description: 在草原上全速奔跑的时候时常引发火灾。毛发蓬松且疏水，毛发内部均能发现未燃尽的火星。被驯服后性情极其温顺。
descriptionEn: It often starts fires when running at full speed across the grasslands. Its fur is fluffy and water-repellent, and unburnt sparks can be found within it. Once tamed, its temperament is extremely gentle.

skills.name: 火焰冲锋
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 引燃
skills.descriptionEn: The enemy gains 10 layers of Burn.

skills.name: 怒火
skills.descriptionEn: Self gains both ATK stats +120% and both DEF stats -40%.

skills.name: 撕咬
skills.description: 造成物伤，3连击，若自己的生命低于50%，本次技能连击数+2。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage, 3 hits; if self HP is below 50%, this skill’s hit count +2.

skills.name: 山火
skills.description: 造成物伤，每使用1次其他火系技能，本技能威力永久翻倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; for each use of another Fire-type skill, this skill’s power permanently doubles.

skills.name: 火云车
skills.description: 对敌方精灵造成物理伤害。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage to the enemy spirit.

skills.name: 热身
skills.description: 下一次攻击时，技能威力翻倍，应对防御：改为威力变为4倍。
skills.descriptionEn: On the next attack, skill power doubles; counters defense: power becomes 4x instead.

skills.name: 闪燃
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：本次技能威力变为4倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; counters status: this skill’s power becomes 4x.

skills.name: 偷袭
skills.description: 造成物伤，应对状态：本次技能威力变为3倍。
skills.descriptionEn: Deals physical damage; counters status: this skill’s power becomes 3x.
